name: SFV OG
summary: SFV OG is a [[kind:cut|cut]] of [[og-kush|OG Kush]] selected in the San Fernando Valley of Los Angeles in the early 2000s. [[breeder:The Cali Connection]] stabilized the Valley cut into seed lines sold as SFV OG Kush.

sources.title: SFV OG
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms OG Kush as the parent, the San Fernando Valley origin, and The Cali Connection as breeder.

sources.title: The San Fernando Valley OG Strain (SFV OG)
sources.note: Places it in the early-2000s OG boom and gives 8–10 weeks indoors.
